cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've torn the prize cheque like you tore yours. Do you want to keep the money or pay for the team trip?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tore off a bank receipt. You've torn the cheque in half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, dividing the amount. Which half are we asking them to replace?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll replace the whole cheque. We could keep half and take a cheaper trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the team we're cutting the trip to keep half the prize. Is that what you want them to hear?

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
